description: Reproducible RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) test vectors for the deterministic gy.locker-screening.v1 manifest recipe defined in docs/ops/GY-OPS-RB-05.md R7. Each vector carries the exact input JSON value, the expected canonical UTF-8 serialization, its byte length, and its SHA-256. For vectors flagged exclude_manifest_sha256, the canonical value and digest are computed after removing the input's top-level manifest_sha256 member (that is the manifest recipe itself). The safe_integer_maximum vector pins the boundary of the supported integer subset — the interoperable safe-integer range |n| <= 2^53 - 1; inputs outside the supported subset (out-of-range integers, invalid Unicode, duplicate member keys) are rejected fail-closed by the CI validator's negative-test matrix. Expected values were verified against an independent RFC 8785 implementation (Node.js JSON.stringify over UTF-16-sorted copies — the ECMAScript serialization normatively referenced by RFC 8785 3.2.2.3) and are enforced by scripts/validate-locker-docs-schemas.py in CI, which additionally cross-checks the Python canonicalizer against the same Node implementation on every run.

vectors.name: non_ascii_property_ordering
vectors.note: Property ordering is by UTF-16 code units (RFC 8785 3.2.3), not Unicode code points: U+1F600 GRINNING FACE (surrogate pair D83D DE00) sorts before U+FF01 FULLWIDTH EXCLAMATION MARK even though its scalar value 0x1F600 is larger than 0xFF01. A code-point sorter would emit the last two members in the opposite order.

vectors.name: numeric_serialization
vectors.note: Numbers serialize per ECMAScript Number::toString (RFC 8785 3.2.2.3): shortest round-trip decimal, ES6 notation thresholds (no exponential form below 1e21, exponent without leading zeros), minus zero as 0. Several values are RFC 8785 Appendix B.2 entries (5e-324, 1.7976931348623157e+308, 9007199254740992, 1e+21, 1e+23, 0.000001, 9.999999999999997e-7, 1424953923781206.2).

vectors.name: safe_integer_maximum
vectors.note: Boundary of the supported integer subset: the interoperable safe-integer range -(2^53 - 1) <= n <= 2^53 - 1. 9007199254740991 (ECMAScript Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) is the largest integer a conforming artifact may carry in any field; integers beyond it are rejected by the artifact schemas, and any integer not exactly representable as an IEEE 754 double is rejected by the canonicalizer (I-JSON).

vectors.name: nested_objects
vectors.note: Canonicalization is recursive: nesting, empty objects, empty arrays, booleans, and null are preserved; member order is sorted at every level.

vectors.name: string_escaping
vectors.note: Strings escape per RFC 8785 3.2.2.2: quotation mark, backslash, and C0 controls only (b f n r t shortcuts); every other character — em dash, guillemets, emoji — is emitted literally as UTF-8, never as \u escapes.

vectors.name: manifest_exclusion
vectors.note: The manifest recipe (GY-OPS-RB-05 R7) hashes the artifact with its top-level manifest_sha256 member removed; every other field present in the artifact is included.

input.retention_date: EXAMPLE: certification lifetime plus at least 2 years

vectors.name: manifest_exclusion_ignores_digest_value
vectors.note: Changing the manifest_sha256 value must not change the computed manifest: this vector differs from manifest_exclusion only in its manifest_sha256 member and therefore yields the identical canonical bytes and SHA-256.
